mechanic.nusmp.floor.rim_curse.name: The Curse of the Rim
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rim_curse.desc: A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rim_curse.flavor: Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.
The Curse of the Rim: Rotting Rim

A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites. The sickness is a creeping rot that eats health instead of the stomach.
Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.
The Curse of the Rim: Footfall
A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites. Running in its area sets it off.
Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rim_curse.c_hold_li: The Curse of the Rim: Lantern-bearer

A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites. Carry a light through it long enough and it relents.
Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.name: The Ebb and Flow of Magic
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.desc: The floor's mana rises and falls like a tide: while it ebbs the delvers' magicules drain away, and the pulse repeats until the tide is turned.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.flavor: Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.e_surge.n: The Ebb and Flow of Magic: Surging Tide
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.e_surge.d: The floor's mana rises and falls like a tide: while it ebbs the delvers' magicules drain away, and the pulse repeats until the tide is turned. At the crest the tide throws the mana back with a shock that hurts.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.e_surge.f: Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.t_area_en: The Ebb and Flow of Magic: Threshold
The floor's mana rises and falls like a tide: while it ebbs the delvers' magicules drain away, and the pulse repeats until the tide is turned. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.
